gaps.explanation: can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.

gaps.explanation: too + adjective + to-infinitive: too young to stay.

gaps.sentence: She can't afford ___ her car repaired this month.
gaps.explanation: afford + to-infinitive: can't afford to get.

gaps.sentence: The rules don't ___ visitors to touch the paintings.
gaps.explanation: allow + object + to-infinitive: allow visitors to touch. (let + bare: let visitors touch.)

gaps.sentence: He suggested ___ a taxi instead of walking.
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (no infinitive with a person: suggest that we take is also possible).

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
We stopped at a village ___ some lunch.
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do something: stopped to have lunch.
